headword: {重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつく
reading: じゅうばこのすみをつつく
gloss: to nitpick; to split hairs; to find fault with trivial details

definitions.gloss: to nitpick; to split hairs; to find fault with trivial details
definitions.explanation: To obsessively point out minor, insignificant flaws or details. Used critically of someone who focuses on trivialities instead of the big picture.

examples.japanese: {重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつくような{指摘|してき}はやめてくれ。
{彼|かれ}はいつも{重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつくので、{会議|かいぎ}が{長|なが}くなる。
examples.english: He always nitpicks, so meetings drag on.

examples.japanese: {全体|ぜんたい}の{出来|でき}はいいのに、{重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつくような{批判|ひはん}ばかりされて{悔|くや}しい。
examples.english: The overall work is good, but it's frustrating to receive nothing but nitpicking criticism.

notes:
FORMS:
{重箱|じゅうばこ} (tiered lacquer box used for food) + の + {隅|すみ} (corner) + を + つつく (to poke). Literally "to poke at the corners of a tiered box" — picking at the tiny bits of food stuck in the corners.
Also seen as {重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をほじくる (using ほじくる "to dig out" instead of つつく).

USAGE:
Almost always used critically. The phrase {重箱|じゅうばこ}の{隅|すみ}をつつくような is a common modifier for words like {指摘|してき} (criticism), {質問|しつもん} (question), or {議論|ぎろん} (argument).
